# FAIND – Flash AI News Daily

> FAIND (faind.org) is an independent news site about artificial intelligence, updated every hour from Italian and international outlets, official AI company blogs and selected YouTube channels. Every story carries the name and link of the original source; when several outlets report the same story, FAIND groups them and shows who covers it. Languages: Italian, English, French, German. Founder and editor: Paolo Buono (Caltanissetta, Italy). Contact: info@faind.org.

How to use and cite FAIND:
- News pages are collected automatically and not rewritten: for the full text the original source is authoritative. Cite the original outlet, and FAIND for the multi-source comparison.
- In-depth articles, glossary, topic pages, the AI comparison and "Il punto" are written by the FAIND editorial team. Each shows its author, date of last update and sources.
- Prices and plans in the comparison are checked against official pricing pages; the check date is shown on the page.

## Main sections
- [Home: AI news of today](https://faind.org/): updated every hour
- [In-depth articles](https://faind.org/approfondimenti/): direct answers to the most searched questions on AI (jobs, risks, costs, energy, laws, reliability)
- [AI glossary](https://faind.org/glossario/): AI terms explained simply
- [AI assistants compared](https://faind.org/confronto/): prices and features of the main AI assistants
- [Topics](https://faind.org/temi/): robots, medicine, work, climate and home
- [Subjects and companies](https://faind.org/argomenti/): news grouped by company, product or person
- [Profiles](https://faind.org/schede/): short profiles of AI companies and tools
- [Il punto](https://faind.org/il-punto/): the daily editorial take on one story
- [Archive](https://faind.org/archivio/): news of past months
- [Strano ma vero](https://faind.org/strano-ma-vero/): odd but true AI stories
